sentences.text: Yueosaurus was a member of the dinosaur class Ornithischia.
The type species of the genus is Yueosaurus tiantaiensis, named after the Tiantai locality where the holotype — the specimen the species is based on — was found.
The generic name Yueosaurus is derived from "Yue", the ancient name for Zhejiang Province.
This genus was first named by Zheng et al. in 2012.
Yueosaurus is classified within the family Thescelosauridae.
It is also a member of the parent group Orodrominae.
Researchers suggest that Yueosaurus might be a member of Jeholosauridae or closely related to it.
Yueosaurus lived between 113.2 and 93.9 million years ago during the Albian to Cenomanian stages.
Fossils were collected from the Liangtoutang Formation in the Albian-Cenomanian stages of the Early to Late Cretaceous.
